name: rtf-coach-plugin
description: Use when asked to convert to RTF, make this an RTF prompt, rewrite / improve / structure this prompt, or mentions the RTF framework, to turn a plain description into a well-structured prompt using the RTF methodology (Role, Task, Format). 支持中文触发，如转成RTF格式、用RTF框架改写、优化/结构化这个提示词等同类表达。
